resources.string: Watches which app is in the foreground so Keyboard Setter can switch your keyboard automatically. Does not read screen content.

Keyboard Setter needs the WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS permission to switch keyboards. Grant it once from a computer with adb:

Tip: for a keyboard you only want in one app, leave it disabled in system settings. It still works here — and staying disabled keeps it out of your manual keyboard switcher.
